title: Manifestations of Xenophobia in AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual review and theoretical evaluation of xenophobic harms (categorized into material, recognition, and rights harms) across multiple AI domains such as social media, immigration, healthcare, employment, and large pre-trained models. The paper proposes frameworks for immanent and transcendent assessment and reviews approaches like counterfactual evaluation, qualitative assessments, and participatory frameworks.
